title: Ujri Nu Chad Ke Kaleya Karbal Wasaan Valeya Sanjha Muka Gaya Aye
body:
Sanjha Mukha Gaya Aye
<<DIVIDER>>
Dasveen Vi Lang Gayi Aye, Kyun Waada Bhul Gaya Aye,
Sathveen Nu Aan Valeya
<<DIVIDER>>
Tere Aan Di Main Veeran, Bethi Haan Aas Laake
Ujre Gharan Ch Akbar, Tak Haal Mera Aake
Rahwaan Main Mal Ke Baithi, Karan Intezaar Tera
Karbal Wasaan Valeya
<<DIVIDER>>
Jado Shaadi Teri Howay, Aawan Main Veer Karbal
Teri Yaad Aake Veeran, Menu Ruwavay Pal Pal
Eho Mere Dil Da Jaaye, Tenu Sehre Lagde Vaikhaan
Na Sehra Laan Valeya
<<DIVIDER>>
Tere Pairaan De Nishaan Main, Kaj Kaj Ke Rowan Akbar
Aaja Ve Chain Menu, Howay Je Kol Asghar
Kadhi Mod Le Muharan, Ujdi Da Veer Akbar
Vichore Vadhaan Valeya
<<DIVIDER>>
Behna De Honde Jagte, Bus Maan Veer Akbar
Veeraan De Naal Behna Da, Wasda Jahaan Akbar
Ek Waari Aaja Veeran, Ro Ro Ke Aakhe Sughra
Dokhan Chipaan Valeya
<<DIVIDER>>
Babay Tere Da Sadqa, Rehni Ye Azadari
Tere Kareeb Mola, Likhan Nohay Zindagi Saari
Sughra Da Veer Akbar, Nanay Da Sadqa Naeem Tu
Nohay Likhaan Valeya
